SettingsPage.title: Settings
SettingsPage.description: Settings page allows you to customize your experience in this application.
SettingsPage.about: Anby is an unofficial wiki website for Zenless Zone Zero players. The images, texts, audio used in this website are sourced from the Zenless Zone Zero Wiki and Hakush.in. The copyright for these materials belongs to Zenless Zone Zero and HoYoverse.
SettingsPage.hoyolabSyncAlert: The information you provide will be used to sync your Hoyolab account with this app. Please note that this information is used solely for processing requests to Hoyolab and is not stored or shared with any third parties.
SettingsPage.hoyolabSyncDescription: To sync your Hoyolab account, you need to provide your UID and your game server. Make sure you public your battle record in Hoyolab settings.
SettingsPage.hoyolabSyncGuide: For more features like daily check-in and viewing your current game progress, you need to provide your ltoken and ltuid. Follow the steps below to get your ltoken and ltuid:
SettingsPage.hoyolabSyncStep1: Open a Desktop Browser, access to HoYoLab and log in to your HoYoLab account.
SettingsPage.hoyolabSyncStep2: Navigate to the Zenless Zone Zero Battle Records page.
SettingsPage.hoyolabSyncStep2Description: You can find it at <records>https://act.hoyolab.com/app/zzz-game-record/index.html#/zzz</records>. Or HoYoLab > Zenless Zone Zero > Battle Records.
SettingsPage.hoyolabSyncStep3: Open the browser's developer tools (F12 or right-click and select "Inspect").
SettingsPage.hoyolabSyncStep3Description: Navigate to the Application tab in the developer tools, then look for the Cookies section in the left sidebar.
SettingsPage.hoyolabSyncStep3Description2: Find the cookie named ltoken_v2 and ltuid_v2, then copy their values and paste them into the form.
SettingsPage.serverDescription: Select your game server. This is required for account sync.
SettingsPage.uidDescription: Your in-game UID. It must be a number between 8 and 10 digits.
SettingsPage.ltokenDescription: Your ltoken for authentication. It should be in the format `v2_xxx.xxx.xxx`.
SettingsPage.ltuidDescription: Your ltuid for authentication. It must be a number.
